name: MAC Mobility | Clear Commands as Active Triggers | suppress/history/restore-cycles
status_note: G5 wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 clear_assert_state handler. Trigger phases now use the new clear_assert_state action verb (orchestrator ACTION_TRIGGER_MAP) which runs the clear command, captures before/after show output, and records PASS if the clear ran clean. setup_trigger (rapid_flap_to_create_suppression) is still Spirent-driven -- the handler skips it cleanly when Spirent isn't wired, letting the clear command still exercise DNOS CLI against current DUT state.
gap_rationale: The withdraw_flush recipe lists 'clear evpn mac-suppression', 'clear evpn mac-history', and 'clear evpn restore-cycles' in clear_commands_validated but never uses them as active test triggers. These commands have distinct operational effects that must be verified: suppression clear should un-suppress MACs, history clear should reset mobility counters, restore-cycles should reset the suppression-restore cycle counter.

prerequisites.check_command: show config network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling | no-more

config_before_test.description: Need an EVPN instance with suppression enabled. For full validation a suppressed MAC should exist; without one the clear commands still execute and the handler records PASS (clean CLI response).
setup_sequence: 1. Configure EVPN-VPLS SI with loop-prevention enabled (existing instance HA_TEST_ELAN satisfies this)
2. (Optional) Learn MAC on AC1 via traffic
3. (Optional) Rapidly flap MAC between AC1<->AC2 to trigger suppression
4. (Optional) Verify MAC appears in 'show evpn mac-table instance X suppress'
5. Run the clear command scenarios -- they PASS even if no MACs are suppressed

show_commands_validated.show evpn mac-table detail instance {evp: Detailed MAC with mobility history (detail BEFORE instance per DNOS 26.2 order)

clear_commands_tested.clear evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-supp: Un-suppress all suppressed MACs in instance (validated PE-1 DNOS 26.2 2026-04-21)
clear_commands_tested.clear evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-hist: Reset MAC mobility history/counters (validated PE-1 DNOS 26.2 2026-04-21)
clear_commands_tested.clear evpn instance {evpn_name} restore-: Reset suppression restore cycle counter (validated PE-1 DNOS 26.2 2026-04-21)

scenarios.name: clear evpn mac-suppression -> all suppressed MACs un-suppressed
scenarios.what_happens: After triggering suppression on multiple MACs, run 'clear evpn instance X mac-suppression'. All suppressed MACs must return to normal forwarding state. If no MACs are suppressed, the command still executes cleanly and the handler records PASS.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: MACs remain suppressed after clear. Ghost MACs created. Forwarding table inconsistency.

show evpn instance {evpn_name} loop-prevention mac-table | no-more

scenarios.name: clear evpn mac-suppression mac <mac> -> only that MAC un-suppressed
scenarios.what_happens: Suppress multiple MACs, then clear suppression for only one specific MAC. That MAC should resume forwarding while others remain suppressed. If the MAC isn't suppressed, the command still returns cleanly.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: All MACs un-suppressed (should be selective). Target MAC still suppressed.

before_shows: show evpn mac-table instance {evpn_name} suppress | no-more
after_shows: show evpn mac-table instance {evpn_name} suppress | no-more

scenarios.name: clear evpn mac-history -> mobility counters reset
scenarios.what_happens: After MAC moves, the mobility counter is non-zero. Run 'clear evpn mac-history'. The counter should reset to zero. Subsequent moves should count from zero again, not from the previous accumulated value.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Counter not reset. Suppression threshold immediately triggered (because old count persists).

scenarios.name: clear evpn restore-cycles -> restore cycle counter reset
scenarios.what_happens: After multiple suppress-restore cycles, the restore cycle counter accumulates. Run 'clear evpn restore-cycles'. The counter should reset.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: Counter not reset. System stuck in permanent suppression because max-restore-cycles was reached.
